name: Hammer

name: Hoe

obtainedFrom: Crafted at a Forge; becomes available once you have Bronze and Corewood
recipe: Corewood x5, Bronze x5 at the Forge. Upgrades: quality 2 Corewood x1 Bronze x1, quality 3 Corewood x2 Bronze x2

name: Fishing Rod
description: Two-handed tool for fishing. Internal ID FishingRod, weight 1.5.

One bait is used per cast
Weak melee: blunt 5
obtainedFrom: Bought from Haldor for 350 Coins
Found at the edge of large frozen lakes in rare Frost Caves; picking it up there also drops 2-4 Fishing bait
Cannot be crafted
gameVersionNote: As of patch 0.213.4, bait is returned if the line is pulled in without catching a fish or when recasting. The Fishing overview page describes the Frost Cave rod as near a rare runestone, the rod page says at the edge of large frozen lakes.

name: Fishing Bait
description: Basic fishing bait (the wiki's "Fishing bait" redirects to the Bait page, which covers all bait types). All baits weigh 0.1 and stack to 100.
usedFor: Fishing: attach to the Fishing Rod by equipping it and right-clicking the bait in the inventory; the bait type decides which fish bite
Basic Fishing bait attracts Perch and Pike (Meadows, Black Forest)
Crafting ingredient for advanced baits at the Food preparation table: 20 Fishing bait plus 1 trophy gives 20 advanced bait
obtainedFrom: Sold by Haldor: 10 Coins per 20 bait
2-4 bait drop when picking up the Fishing Rod found in a Frost Cave
recipe: Advanced bait types (20 basic bait + trophy -> 20 bait): Mossy (Troll trophy) attracts Trollfish, Black Forest; Sticky (Abomination trophy) attracts Giant herring, Swamp; Stingy (Fuling trophy) attracts Grouper, Plains; Heavy (Serpent trophy) attracts Tuna and Coral cod, Ocean; Misty (Lox trophy) attracts Pufferfish and Anglerfish, Mistlands (both) and Ocean (Pufferfish); Hot (Warrior trophy) attracts Magmafish, Ashlands; Frosty (Drake trophy) attracts Northern salmon, Deep North; Cold (Fenring trophy) attracts Pike (Meadows and Black Forest) and Tetra (Frost Caves)
gameVersionNote: The Fishing page says the different fish and bait types were introduced in the Mistlands update.
